relevance.rationale: WRONG JOIN. The seeded id was andrews1976, whose registered entry is a monograph with a single author and an ISBN. This PDF is arXiv:2401.04019v1 [math.CO], a two-author research article on truncated theta series related to the Jacobi Triple Product identity — a different work entirely and a different document type, so no upload of the registered monograph actually exists. No matching key found in references.ts, so id is null. ON THE MERITS for this folio: the document proves the first three cases of a stronger truncated-JTP conjecture and gives a combinatorial interpretation for 5-regular partitions. The folio's only partition-function consumer is folio/quantum-observable-universe/mass-theory/a8-partition-function-identity.lean, which needs nothing beyond the five values p(1..5) = 1,2,3,5,7 (already available from Mathlib's Nat.Partition), and the QBeta work uses cyclotomic expansions rather than truncated theta identities. I can name no block that would consume a truncated-JTP inequality. Scope: this document, as read, supplies nothing usable here — not a claim that truncated theta methods are excluded from the framework. SEPARATELY on the andrews1976 citation itself (its one site, mass-theory/a8-partition-function-identity.lean:55): it is a plausible background pointer for a p(n) value table but does very little work, since the Lean file's own commentary says the bridge is to Mathlib's Fintype.card (Nat.Partition n) by decidability.
